title: Kakuna Looks Helpless, But Its Hot Shell Gives It Away
premise: Kakuna looks frozen on a tree, but its shell gets hot because it is intensely preparing to evolve inside.
audiencePromise: Reveal why a nearly motionless Kakuna has a hot shell, then uncover the body changes hidden inside.
openLoop: Why would a helpless cocoon feel hot to touch?
payoff: Kakuna’s heat is the clue that it is rebuilding for evolution, with a softening body beneath a hardening shell.
engagementQuestion: Hard shell or hidden work: which impresses you more?

voice.instructions: {"tone":"quietly mysterious, then increasingly amazed","pacing":"short deliberate phrases with a stronger lift on each reveal","delivery":"stress helpless, hot, inside, softens, and hardens"}

scenes.headline: THIS COCOON RUNS HOT
scenes.narration: Kakuna looks helpless. Its hot shell gives it away.
scenes.caption: A STILL COCOON WITH A HOT SECRET

scenes.headline: IT CLINGS TO A TREE
scenes.narration: It clings to a tree, nearly unable to move.
scenes.caption: NO ESCAPE. JUST A STILL COCOON.

scenes.headline: THE SHELL BETRAYS IT
scenes.narration: But its hot shell exposes activity hidden inside.
scenes.caption: THE HEAT DOES NOT MATCH THE STILLNESS

scenes.headline: IT IS MAKING A BODY
scenes.narration: Inside, Kakuna busily prepares its body for evolution.
scenes.caption: THE COCOON IS A TEMPORARY STAGE

scenes.headline: SOFT BODY. HARD SHELL.
scenes.narration: Its body softens while the outer shell hardens.
scenes.caption: REBUILDING UNDER ITS PROTECTIVE SHELL

scenes.headline: THE HEAT IS THE CLUE
scenes.narration: Hard shell or hidden work: which impresses you more?
scenes.caption: HEAT REVEALS THE EVOLUTION INSIDE
